note: Names and guidance live here. Tokens: {BOT}, {OWNER}, {NAME}, {PLANET}, {TURN_LEFT}, {TURN_RIGHT}; turn keys resolve from InputMap.

intro.note: The opening cutscene's radio (scripts/intro_cutscene.gd). In a line, | is where the signal breaks up: what follows it is drawn as static.
intro.speaker: MISSION CONTROL
approach: THIS IS MISSION CONTROL. YOU'RE CLOSING IN ON PLANET {PLANET}... FAST.
orbit: THE CREW BEFORE YOU BUILT A BASE DOWN THERE. THEN THEY WENT SILENT.
PICK UP WHERE THEY LEFT OFF. YOUR MISSION: MAKE {PLANET} A PLACE PEOPLE CAN LIVE.
descent: BEGINNING DESCENT. A SOLAR STORM JUST LIT UP OUR SCOPES!
WATCH OUT FOR THE RADIATION WA|KSSHHT... BZZZT... VZZ

correction: ...YOU ARE NOT {OWNER}? THEN WHO ARE YOU?
named: SORRY, {NAME}. THE LAST FACE I SAW HERE WAS {OWNER}'S.
objectives_intro: FIRST, REPAIR THE O2 GENERATOR IN THE WEST ROOM.
THEN WE WILL SEAL THE GLASS AND RESTORE MAIN POWER.

remind.both: THE REACTOR AND THE O2 GENERATOR STILL NEED YOU, {NAME}.
remind.power: THE REACTOR STILL NEEDS YOU. POWER ROOM, EAST.
remind.oxygen: THE O2 GENERATOR STILL NEEDS YOU. OXYGEN ROOM, WEST.

lines: THE DUST HERE IS FINER THAN FLOUR. IT GETS INTO EVERYTHING.
THE COMMS DISH SITS UP ON THE ICE.
ITS BEACON HAS BEEN CALLING FOR 412 DAYS. NOBODY ANSWERED.

nursery_intro: YES, IT IS STILL {BOT}. SAME MIND, DIFFERENT BODY.
THIS BODY MAINTAINS THE NURSERY. THANK YOU FOR THE REPAIR.
REPAIR THE CONSOLE FIRST TO SWITCH ON NURSERY POWER.
THEN REPAIR THE GROW LIGHT AND DAMAGED RACK.
I WILL VACUUM THE SOIL, DEAD LEAVES AND TRAY CHIPS WHILE YOU WORK.
EMBERPODS GROW ON THE RACKS AND REPLENISH FOOD. FIND THEIR SEEDS IN WILD CINDERCOIL.
DEWPODS GROW IN THE SILOS AND REPLENISH WATER. THEIR SEEDS COME FROM WILD MOONWELLS.
MOONWELLS OPEN ONLY AT NIGHT, FROM 20:00 UNTIL 05:00. COLLECT THEIR SEEDS WHILE OPEN.
BOTH CROPS TAKE A FULL DAY TO GROW. HARVEST THE FRUIT WHEN IT IS RIPE.
nursery_remind: RACKS FOR EMBERPODS, SILOS FOR DEWPODS. BOTH TAKE A DAY TO GROW.
COLLECT MOONWELL SEEDS AT NIGHT, BETWEEN 20:00 AND 05:00.

oxygen: START WITH THE O2 GENERATOR, {NAME}. OXYGEN ROOM, WEST.
REPAIR ITS CRACKS AND WIRING WITH YOUR MULTITOOL. YOUR SUIT AIR IS LIMITED.
glass: O2 GENERATOR REPAIRED. IT IS RUNNING ON RESERVE POWER.
SEAL ALL THREE STORAGE WINDOWS NEXT, OR THE OXYGEN WILL LEAK OUT.
MOVE THE CARGO BOX UNDER EACH HOLE AND STAND ON IT TO REPAIR THE GLASS.
TURN THE VIEW WITH {TURN_LEFT} AND {TURN_RIGHT} TO FIND THE CRACK AT THE BACK.
AFTER THE GLASS, REPAIR THE GENERATOR AND ALIGN THE SOLAR FIELD FOR LASTING O2.
power: THE STORAGE WINDOWS ARE SEALED. NOW REPAIR THE MAIN GENERATOR IN THE EAST ROOM.
RESERVE POWER IS TEMPORARY. THE GENERATOR AND ALL THREE SOLAR ROUTES MUST WORK TOGETHER.
solar: THE GENERATOR IS REPAIRED. FINISH THE SOLAR FIELD OUTSIDE.
OPEN THE THREE SUN FEEDS, THEN TURN THE MIRRORS TO CONNECT AMBER, JADE AND CORAL TO THE COLLECTOR.
ALL THREE ROUTES ARE NEEDED TO KEEP O2 PRODUCTION RUNNING.
done: GLASS SEALED. GENERATOR AND SOLAR ONLINE. O2 SUPPLY STABLE.
YOU CAN BREATHE AND REFILL YOUR SUIT IN THE BASE AND NURSERY. THE NURSERY TANK SHARES THIS GENERATOR.
MAIN POWER FEEDS THE DISH UP ON THE ICE. REPAIR ITS SCREEN AND SEND AN SOS TO EARTH.
CHECK THE STORM WARNING BEFORE CROSSING. THE DISH PEDESTAL CAN SHELTER YOU WHILE YOU WAIT FOR A REPLY.

access: MAIN POWER IS DOWN. RELEASING MAINTENANCE BULKHEADS.
BULKHEADS OPEN. O2 HAS ITS OWN LIMITED RESERVE ONCE REPAIRED.

reply.note: Earth's answer, played once at the comms screen (scripts/story/reply_cutscene.gd). The message lines run together and wrap on the terminal; eta is drawn large under them.
message: WE WILL BE SENDING A RESCUE TEAM.
reply.astronaut: GUESS I GOTTA SURVIVE FOR A YEAR HERE...
